mapper.select: SELECT ddpvup.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.user_source, t.version, t.user_num, t.pkg_user_num, t.user_rate, t.pkg_cost, t.pkg_change_cost, t.cost, t.change_cost, t.cpi FROM (SELECT ddpr.dates, ddpr.pkg, ddpr.network user_source, ddpvur.version, ddpvur.user_num, durpfd.user_num pkg_user_num, IFNULL((ddpvur.user_num / durpfd.user_num), 0) user_rate, IFNULL(ddpr.total_cost, 0) pkg_cost, IFNULL(ddpr.total_change_cost, 0) pkg_change_cost, IFNULL((ddpvur.user_num / durpfd.user_num) * ddpr.total_cost, 0) cost, IFNULL((ddpvur.user_num / durpfd.user_num) * ddpr.total_change_cost, 0) change_cost, IFNULL((ddpvur.user_num / durpfd.user_num) * ddpr.total_change_cost / ddpvur.user_num, 0) cpi FROM (SELECT dpr.dates, dpr.pkg, dpr.network, sum(dpr.cost) total_cost, sum(dpr.change_cost) total_change_cost FROM dwd_promotion_record dpr WHERE dpr.dates = #{dates} group by dpr.dates, dpr.pkg, dpr.network) ddpr LEFT JOIN dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_register ddpvur on (ddpvur.dates = ddpr.dates and ddpvur.pkg = ddpr.pkg and ddpvur.user_source = ddpr.network) LEFT JOIN dws_user_register_pkg_full_daily durpfd on (ddpr.dates = durpfd.dates and ddpr.pkg = durpfd.pkg)) t left join dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_promotion ddpvup on (t.dates = ddpvup.dates and t.pkg = ddpvup.pkg and t.version = ddpvup.version and t.user_source = ddpvup.user_source)
